request: mix: CSVに行内容由来の固定UUIDを付けMarkdown表にする / 標準入力またはファイルからCSV（1行目はヘッダ）を読み、各行の内容から決定的に作るUUID（SHA-1による名前ベースv5、固定の名前空間）を先頭の id 列に付けて、Markdown の表を標準出力に出す。同じ内容の行は何度実行しても同じIDになり、行を並べ替えても変わらない。例：「name,qty\nりんご,3」を入力すると「| id | name | qty |」のヘッダ行、区切り行、続いて「| 6f1c…(UUID) | りんご | 3 |」を出力する。セル内の | はエスケープする。フラグは -s（IDを短く先頭8文字にする）のみ。コマンド名は mdid

spec.name: mdid
spec.summary: mdid reads CSV from a file or stdin and prints a Markdown table with a deterministic UUID v5 id column computed from each row's content.

flags.name: s
flags.help: shorten each id to its first 8 characters

behavior: B1: Takes at most one positional argument, a CSV file path; with none, reads stdin. More than one argument prints "mdid: usage: mdid [-s] [file]" to stderr and exits 2. Flag errors exit 2.

B2: Parse with encoding/csv (FieldsPerRecord = -1, otherwise defaults). If the file cannot be opened or the CSV is malformed, print "mdid: " followed by the error text to stderr, nothing to stdout, and exit 1.
B3: If the input has no records (empty or only blank lines), print "mdid: empty input" to stderr and exit 1.

B4: The first record is the header with N fields. Output line 1 is "| id | " + header cells joined by " | " + " |". Line 2 is the separator: "| " + (N+1) copies of "---" joined by " | " + " |". Every output line ends with a single newline.

B5: Each later record is one data row, printed in input order as "| <id> | " + cells joined by " | " + " |". A row with fewer than N fields is padded with empty strings; fields beyond N are dropped. An empty cell prints as nothing between its separators (e.g. "| <id> | 1 |  |"). Input with only a header prints just lines 1 and 2 and exits 0.

B6: Cell text (header and data) is escaped for output: each | becomes \| (backslash then pipe), and each CRLF, LF or CR becomes
. Backslashes are otherwise unchanged.

B7: The id is a UUID v5 (RFC 4122): SHA-1 over the 16 bytes of the fixed namespace 6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8 followed by the UTF-8 name, where the name is the row's N fields (after padding/dropping, before escaping) joined by a single NUL byte. Take the first 16 bytes of the digest, set byte 6 to (b&0x0f)|0x50 and byte 8 to (b&0x3f)|0x80, and print as lowercase hex 8-4-4-4-12. The id depends only on the row's content, never on position, so identical rows get identical ids and reordering rows does not change them.
B8: With -s each id is cut to its first 8 characters. Nothing is written to stdout before the whole input has parsed successfully.
